claim: The General Assembly session begins the first Tuesday of January each year
quote: There shall be a session of the general assembly at Providence commencing on the first Tuesday of January in each year

claim: A bill not returned within six days (Sundays excepted) becomes law
quote: If the measure shall not be returned by the governor within six days (Sundays excepted) after it shall have been presented to the governor the same shall become operative

claim: After adjournment the governor has ten days to transmit a veto, or the bill becomes law
quote: disapproval in writing within ten days after such adjournment

claim: Statutes without a stated date take effect 1 July if enacted by then, otherwise on passage
quote: shall take effect on the first day of July of the calendar year of its enactment into law by the general assembly

claim: The general election is the Tuesday after the first Monday in November in even years
quote: means an election held on the first Tuesday next after the first Monday in November in even numbered years

claim: Every city and town votes in November of even years for state and federal offices and any other officers chosen that day
quote: and for any other officers that are to be chosen on that day

claim: City and town elective meetings are held biennially in even years on the November date
quote: A meeting of the electors of every city, town, senatorial district, representative district, and of every voting district shall be held biennially in the even years on the Tuesday next after the first Monday in November

claim: Town elective meetings are held at the times appointed by law
quote: shall be held at the times appointed by law

claim: A town meeting is held annually or biennially as required by law to elect town officers
quote: A town meeting shall be held annually or biennially as required by law in each town, for the election of those town officers as are required by law

claim: The party primary is held on the eighth Tuesday before the biennial state election
quote: on the eighth Tuesday preceding biennial state elections

claim: Fire, water and sewer district officer meetings are not elections under the election title
quote: except that it shall not include a financial town meeting or a meeting to elect officers of a fire, water, or sewer district

claim: An election includes town and city offices and party primaries
quote: includes without limitation any state, town, or city office or question, and any political party primary election for the nomination of any candidate for public office

claim: Unaffiliated voters who vote in a party primary remain unaffiliated
quote: Whenever an unaffiliated voter participates in a party primary, their party affiliation shall remain unaffiliated

claim: A voter affiliated with a party may not vote in another party primary until changing affiliation
quote: shall be debarred from voting in the primary as a member of the opposite political party until that person has changed his or her party affiliation

claim: Unaffiliated voters are not barred from a primary because of an earlier primary
quote: Any person who is not affiliated with any political party shall not be debarred from voting in a party primary due to their participation in a previous party primary while not affiliated with a party

claim: A party member may change affiliation up to the thirtieth day before a primary
quote: may change the designation on or before the thirtieth day preceding any primary election for which the person is eligible

claim: Signing nomination papers does not affiliate a voter with a party
quote: No person shall be affiliated with any political party solely because of that person

claim: Party and independent candidates file declarations of candidacy in late June of even years, including for local office
quote: During the last consecutive Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday in June in the even years

claim: Local candidates file with the local board
quote: or with the appropriate local board for local officers

claim: A party candidate must not have been in another party within 90 days of filing
quote: that person shall not have been a member of a political party other than the declared political party within ninety (90) days of the filing of their declaration of candidacy

claim: An independent candidate is one with no party affiliation
quote: means a candidate who has no affiliation with any political party

claim: Independent candidates must be qualified to vote in the district
quote: No person shall be eligible to file a declaration of candidacy as an independent candidate

claim: A voter may sign any number of nomination papers
quote: A voter may sign any number of nomination papers for any office the voter may lawfully vote for at the general election

claim: Party and independent nomination papers are checked by the local board
quote: Each nomination paper for party and independent candidates shall be submitted

claim: State law refers to nonpartisan council and school elections in Newport, Pawtucket and Woonsocket and partisan ones in North Providence
quote: candidates for nonpartisan election in the cities of Newport, Pawtucket, and Woonsocket, and candidates for partisan election in the town of North Providence

claim: Council and school committee elections may be partisan or nonpartisan
quote: whether the election is a partisan, nonpartisan, primary, general, or special election

claim: City mayors are elected by plurality
quote: Mayors of cities shall be elected by a plurality of the electors

claim: Every city and town may adopt a charter and local laws not inconsistent with the constitution and state law
quote: Every city and town shall have the power at any time to adopt a charter, amend its charter

claim: Home rule is the right of self government in local matters
quote: the right of self government in all local matters

claim: Every city and town has an elected legislative body of one or two branches
quote: every city and town shall have a legislative body composed of one or two branches elected by vote of its qualified electors

claim: The General Assembly may legislate for cities and towns by general laws that do not change their form of government
quote: by general laws which shall apply alike to all cities and towns, but which shall not affect the form of government of any city or town

claim: Towns elect a moderator, town clerk, a town council of 3 to 7 members, treasurer, sergeant and other officers as required
quote: a town council to consist of not less than three (3) nor more than seven (7) members

claim: Town officers include a moderator and town clerk
quote: a moderator to preside in all the meetings of the town, and a town clerk

claim: School committees have three members or the number now set, in staggered classes
quote: The school committee of each city or town shall consist of three (3) residents of the city or town, or of any number as at the present time constitute the committee

claim: In biennial-election places the school committee is split into two classes
quote: In cities or towns having biennial elections the committee shall be divided as equally as may be into two (2) classes

claim: School committees manage the public schools of each city and town
quote: the entire care, control, and management of all public school interests of the several cities and towns shall be vested in the school committees

claim: The unaffiliated-voter primary rule took effect in 2024
